item.blurb: Bodhium Labs Raises $3.5M Pre-seed. Bodhium Labs raises $3.5M pre-seed round led by Streamlined Ventures and Long Journey Ventures to build an AI simulation and testing layer for marketers.
Augmeta Raises $3M Seed. Augmeta raises $3M seed round led by Depth Ventures to expand its Agentic KPI Ops platform and deploy AI operators to manage business performance.
Photon Raises $4.5M Seed. Photon raises $4.5M in seed funding led by Gradient and A* to help developers build AI agents that replace traditional mobile applications.
Parakeet Health Raises $10M Series A. Parakeet Health raises $10M Series A led by Canvas Ventures to scale its AI-driven patient access and engagement platform for healthcare enterprises.
Homeward Raises $120M Series D. Homeward raises $120M Series D led by Saluda Grade to expand its AI-powered proptech platform for home buying and selling solutions.
Biotia Raises $9M in Funding. Biotia raises $9 million to scale its AI-powered infectious disease diagnostic platform and expand into women's health and orthopedic testing markets.
